notes.title: DEVLOG #01 — CLAYMOTION: MONKEY TOY 🐒
notes.content:
Hey there! My name is Ibai Aizpurua and I'm the creator of Barraka.
Right now, I’m in the final stages of developing the game 🛠️.
If you’re reading this, I’m guessing it’s probably because you were drawn in by the game’s art style 🎨.

Barraka has a clay aesthetic. In fact — it’s entirely made out of clay! 🧽
Maybe not the most logical decision when making a game, but as a stop motion lover, you don’t really see many games created with this technique these days 🎬.

The game takes place in a small village (which could be your hometown or where you grew up). Everything happens in the village square and gardens, where you’ll find fairs and merry-go-rounds 🎠.
The witch’s curse gives me the freedom to include all sorts of worlds and enemies in the game. The monkey toy is one of them. We find it inside a classic claw machine — the same kind of sneaky machine that ate so many of our coins as kids 🎰.

Even though the classic monkey toy is very American, I’ve always been fascinated by it and it’s super fun to animate 🐒. That’s why I decided to create my own version and include it in Barraka.

Like with all elements in the game, after many little sketches, I like to define the character in a final illustration or piece of concept art ✏️🖌️.
Although I enjoy digital drawing, I’m definitely faster with pencil and watercolors 🖼️.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063702/06b6a3ad30b9a4c637c420b32a4869d273b04d4f.png[/img]

Since the monkey is one of the most complex characters to animate, I decided to animate it in separate parts. This gives me a lot more control over the work. Traditional stop motion can be tricky when you need to fix or adjust animations ⚙️.

First, I model all the necessary parts. Then I start creating the frames, lighting them, and taking photos in my small setup 📸.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063702/1cc1a933d20039e40301a9b8de6ac309349bb378.gif[/img]

Likewise, I decided to animate the arms and cymbals independently 🥁.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063702/effa32767823b9be06c38a2d116680f0fa6c636d.png[/img]

Once I bring the images to the computer, I clean them up by hand and start building the animations. In the case of the head, it’s animated “traditionally” with stop motion, frame by frame — except for the pupils, which are digital, just like the rest of the characters 👁️💻.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063702/7049241be017696317389846a65bfbc81999e5bb.gif[/img]

Since I didn’t put much effort into polishing the walking cycle at first, the first draft looks quite rough and confusing 🌀.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063702/06e30d94594ea187b8507ee9442822d943b0bc05.png[/img]

At this point, I take advantage of working digitally. I can warp and adjust the proportions of each part freely, achieving much smoother animations 💫. I also added an extra frame for the head to better match the rhythm of the body.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063702/6628feffa7f674d32079ff500e18101646004508.gif[/img]

Finally, it’s time to complete this digital “Frankenstein” by putting together the arms and all the head frames. I also add digital shadows to make it look like everything is made from a single piece 🧩.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063702/fbec3fc68e0c8744da44b1363fc1a9b98a2f2b0d.gif[/img]

Honestly, I’m really proud of this little animation 🥹. With just a few frames, it manages to create the illusion of a pretty complex walking cycle 💃.

As you can see, the process I use varies depending on what I’m animating. I call it hybrid animation, since I combine traditional stop motion, cut-out, and sprite animation 🔁.

I hope you enjoyed this short read about the process behind one of the parts of Barraka 💖.

Ibai 👋

notes.title: Barraka at Weird Market 2024
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!
We’re super excited to share that Barraka, our beloved little game crafted with love by Zomorro Studio and published by Dojo System, has been awarded the RTVE Interactive/Fallo de Sistema Award for Weird Plus Video Game at the 16th edition of the Weird Market!

[previewyoutube=WQ37NY_Ca98;full][/previewyoutube]
[url=https://weirdmarket.es/en/2024/10/05/weird-market-premia-los-mejores-proyectos-y-cortos-de-animacion-y-videojuegos-en-su-16o-edicion/]Here’s all the info [/url]

This is a dream come true for us, and we couldn’t have achieved it without your support. Your passion and encouragement have been key every step of the way.

Barraka is our love letter to the ’90s, featuring a small-town fair brought to life with claymotion art, heartwarming characters, and levels packed with humor and magic. You can already add it to your wishlist on Steam and PlayStation 5. Plus, it will soon be available on Nintendo Switch and Xbox Series!

Thank you for being there and for being part of this incredible adventure. Every little milestone is yours too.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063702/2a06d586f9e1932f9fc0ebe737df6843a44ea358.jpg[/img]
With a big warm hug,
Ibai

notes.title: Dojo System's latest banger takes you to the fair by the hand of Barraka!
notes.content:
[h1]Dojo System's latest firecracker takes you to the fair by the hand of Zomorro Studio🎪![/h1].

[previewyoutube=jcsuZnav9js;full][/previewyoutube]
Join Ainhoa on her exciting adventure through a mysterious village fair set in the 90's! This amazing journey will be packed with exploration, puzzles and surprises, from her mother's warm churro stand to an epic showdown with the wicked witch and her minions. As you collect coins and progress through this magical and fascinating amusement park, you will encounter new levels, challenges, huts and mini-games. Barraka's incredible world has been meticulously created by hand with plasticine and animated using the stop motion technique.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063702/2a9267135d58adab71d30683b507ef2ae8806f75.png[/img]
Get ready to meet and help unforgettable characters while facing colorful enemies that will make you laugh your head off. Visit the haunted house, explore a mysterious mini-circus, ride the bumper cars, or enjoy a merry-go-round that transforms into a horizontal scrolling space shooter with a boss ending - every corner of Barraka Fair holds surprises that are as fun as they are challenging!

You can now add Barraka to your wishlist on Steam thanks to Dojo System.

[b]Characteristics:[/b]
[list]
[*] Beautifully crafted graphics that combines real images, stop motion and traditional animation to recreate an amazing plasticine universe.
[*] A magical world where lovable characters and disturbing enemies coexist.
[*] Enjoy unforgettable attractions: the bumper cars, the merry-go-round, the haunted house and much more.
[Test your wits, complete challenging levels and find all the coins.
[*] Have fun with classic mini-games that will test your skills such as mole smashing or target shooting.
[*] Buy new equipment and upgrade it to help Ainhoa progress in her adventure and discover all the secrets of the mysterious amusement park.
[*] Let yourself be caught by its ambient soundtrack and its hilarious sound effects.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3041440/Barraka/
